set.body: P8.02 follow-up. ViewerState.cursor and ViewerAction.SetCursor are untyped WorldPoint; SurfaceWorldLink.toVolume (SurfaceDynamics.scala) accepts a volume grid in any world, so a tkRAS surface over an MNI grid links silently (used by SurfaceNetwork, ThreeVolumeProjector). Deprecate in favour of ViewerCursor / SurfaceVolumeCursor over WorldLink. Blocked on coordinating with the uncommitted work in image-view Interaction/Layer and surface-view SurfaceDynamics/SurfaceViewTypes.
set.title: STP follow-up: retire untyped viewer links (ViewerState.cursor, SurfaceWorldLink.toVolume)
